The '''Seventh Guard''' was an [[Praetorian Guard|Elite Praetorian Guard]] who served as the personal [[Bodyguard|guard]] of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]], leader of the [[First Order]]. The guard wielded [[vibro-arbir blade]]s.<ref name="TLJVD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The Seventh Guard met their [[Death|demise]] on board the ''[[Supremacy]]'' when [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], Snoke's apprentice, betrayed him with the help of [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], another [[Force-sensitive]] individual. Together they [[Battle of Oetchi|defeated]] and killed all of the Elite Praetorian Guards in the [[Snoke's throne room|throne room]].<ref name="Episode VIII" />

==Biography==
The Seventh [[Bodyguard|Guard]] was a member of the [[Praetorian Guard|Elite Praetorian Guard]]—[[Color|crimson]] [[Soldier|warriors]] who served as the personal bodyguards of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]] of the [[First Order]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> They were one of the two guards equipped with [[vibro-arbir blade]]s. The Seventh Guard was stationed in [[Snoke's throne room]] with along with the other Praetorian Guards at the [[time]] of [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren's]] audience with the Supreme Leader<ref name="Episode VIII" /> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> Angered by Snoke's disapproving appraisal of his [[Battle of Starkiller Base|defeat]] on [[Starkiller Base]],<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref> the [[Ren|Master]] of the [[Knights of Ren]] took a step in his master's direction, causing the Seventh Guard to snap into a combat stance against the [[Dark side of the Force|dark]] apprentice as his fellows.<ref name="Expanded Edition">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]''</ref>

[[File:VibroArbirBlades-CM.png|thumb|left|250px|The Seventh Guard faces Rey]]
The Seventh Guard was still present in the [[throne]] room when Ren returned with the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan|learner]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] as his [[prisoner]]. However, instead of executing the former [[scavenger]] as Snoke ordered, Ren chose to [[assassin]]ate his master—resulting in a [[Battle of Oetchi|confrontation]] between the two [[Force-sensitive]]s and the Praetorian Guards. Like the other Praetorians, the Seventh Guard attempted to avenge the slain Supreme Leader,<ref name="Expanded Edition" /> engaging the traitorous apprentice and Rey. One of the vibro-arbir-wielding guards was quickly [[Death|killed]] during the opening clash. After the death of another guard at the hands of Rey, the other vibro-arbir blade-wielding guard engaged the Padawan immediately after she sent the a guard's [[Bilari electro-chain whip|whip]] flying towards the room's curtain behind them, setting it on [[fire]].<ref name="Episode VIII" />

Separating their weapon in two, the guard proved to be a fitting opponent to Rey, even injuring her with one of their blades in her right [[Limb|arm]]. Overpowering the Jedi, the guard kicked her in the [[stomach]], causing her to fall to the floor. They then subdued her at the edge of the suspended platform, grabbing her from the armlock, but Rey outsmarted them by letting go [[Skywalker lightsaber|her]] [[lightsaber]] and then grabbing it, cutting the guard's right leg and then striking it on their neck, causing them to fall off the platform to an assured demise. The last Praetorian was killed soon after.<ref name="Episode VIII" />
